$comment: Gzipped bytes. entry: the entry chunk with its static imports; routes: a route file's split chunks with the static imports the entry does not already load; css: all emitted CSS. A task that needs more raises the budget in the same PR and says why. U-02 raised entry from 150000 to 175000: the authenticated shell (sidebar, engine switcher, trust mark with SHA-256, user menu, drawer, step-up dialog, toaster, route states) and the Paraglide runtime with both catalogues render on every route, so they belong in the entry; measured 168130. Raised to 200000 on 2026-10-21 (Seb): at 173803 an audit of the entry found it is framework and contract code (react-dom, zod, TanStack Router and Query, engine-api schemas, @ptbk/ui shell components); Paraglide already tree-shakes messages per route, and the only engine-ui code left to split was route loaders (about 1 kB), not worth a serial chunk fetch before every cold navigation. U-04 gave the book editor and the create-agent wizard budgets of their own: both load CodeMirror 6 (view, state, language, lint, search, history; merge for the editor's diff), about 105000 shared, which the entry never loads (ADR 0013). Measured: agents/$agentId/book.tsx 158808 (CodeMirror with merge, the history DataTable), agents/new.tsx 158133 (CodeMirror, the form layer, the knowledge upload, the chat panel for the test step); the entry grew by 413 (the two routes' guards, search schema and loader, and the Book tab's registration). U-13 raised agents/new.tsx from 165000 to 168000: the test step carries the book editor's throwaway test chat beside the kept-chat fallback; measured 165022. U-13 raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 170000 to 171000: the trigger form reuses the book's unsaved-changes guard, so the guard moves into a chunk both routes share; measured 170200. Raised entry from 200000 to 215000 on 2026-11-03: home, where opening an engine lands, is no longer split from the entry (vite.config.ts). Split, it was 23 chunks of 17 kB gzip in all, fetched after the entry ran and queued behind HTTP/1.1's six connections; at Fast 3G its first screen went from 5.4 s to 3.4 s. Measured 209991. C-14 raised entry from 215000 to 217000: the engine-api chat schemas and readers gained reply steps, working agents, linked tasks and rechecks, which every chat read parses; measured 215391. U-16 (part A) raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 171000 to 176000 and agents/new.tsx from 168000 to 171500: both embed a chat (the book's test chat, the wizard's test step), which now carries the reference chips, their parser and hovercards, agent colours and the composer's @ suggestions; measured 175013 and 170543. Lazy-loading the hovercard bodies would save about 1 kB of that and delay every first hover, so they stay in. The entry did not grow: the chat loader's markdown preload moved to a module of its own, so the thread renderers left the entry (measured 215240). U-16 part B raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 176000 to 181500 and agents/new.tsx from 171500 to 176500: both embed the chat panel, which now builds agent turns, steps, task and reply-status cards, day dividers and the interim progress parser; measured 180649 and 175688. U-17 (foundations) raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 181500 to 183000 and agents/new.tsx from 176500 to 178000: their embedded chat's chips now compose @ptbk/ui's EntityChip with its status dot, and a profile colour's label colours are derived per theme (OKLCH lightness search) so arbitrary agent colours stay AA; measured 182377 and 177428. The entry did not grow past its budget (215387). U-17 (tables) raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 181500 to 184000: its history DataTable now carries the restyled table (group headers, header icons, two-line narrow rows, the toolbar hand-off for the filter bar) on top of the foundations' tokens and restyled controls; measured 183362. With the U-17 foundations' restyled controls (Combobox, DateInput, StatusPill, Avatar) merged in, agents/new.tsx measured 177706, so U-17 (tables) raised it from 176500 to 178500. U-17 revision 1 (foundations) raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 184000 to 186000 and agents/new.tsx from 178500 to 180500: the embedded chat's agent and task hovercards are now @ptbk/ui PeekCards (header, status pill, facts, footer action with the Enter shortcut); measured 185352 and 179694. U-17 (shell and screens) kept the entry at 217000: Home turned Chatter-first (the chat composer, entity chips with hovercards, and the Needs you, Working now and Recent chats sections), and that content and the activity feed now load as two chunks the home route starts fetching before it asks the engine anything, so they arrive with the data rather than after it. The greeting, update notice and onboarding notice stay in the entry; measured 207763, and 212788 after the foundations' revision 1. After the foundations' revision 1 the chip core is shared from the entry again, so runs/index.tsx and tasks/index.tsx are back within the default (measured 46005 and 45350) and agents/$agentId/book.tsx fits the foundations' 186000 (measured 185783). U-17 (shell and screens) raised agents/new.tsx from 180500 to 181500: the wizard's test chat now carries the entity chips' code and activity lines; measured 180960. U-17 (shell and screens, revision 2) raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 186000 to 186500: the neutral entity chip's hairline ring ships with the book's test chat; measured 186020. U-17 phase 2 (admin screens) gave audit.tsx 53000 and members.tsx 51000: the audit log moved to the shared DataTable and FilterBar (entity, enum and date-range fields, member chips with their hovercards, the device parser), and Members to the DataTable with avatars, the soft needs-you rows and Combobox role pickers; measured 52497 and 50521. The same PR raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 186500 to 187500, agents/new.tsx from 181500 to 182500 and gave agents/$agentId/files.tsx 50500: none of them changed, but with the admin screens now importing Combobox, FilterBar and Avatar, Rollup regroups the shared chunks these routes load; measured 186886, 181970 and 50030. U-17 phase 2 (work screens) raised these routes, measured after the rebase on phase 1: files.tsx to 62000 (measured 60993), triggers/index.tsx to 54000 (53335), triggers/$triggerId/index.tsx to 51000 (50355), integrations/index.tsx to 52000 (51229), agents/$agentId/files.tsx to 52500 (51822), agents/$agentId/triggers.tsx to 54500 (53624), agents/$agentId/integrations.tsx to 51000 (50082), agents/$agentId/book.tsx to 187500 (187021) and agents/new.tsx to 183000 (182316). The lists moved from native fields to the shared FilterBar with its entity, multi-value and date fields, and their rows now carry entity chips (with the lazily loaded peek cards' triggers), status pills and the row ⋯ menu; the trigger form's native selects became Comboboxes and DateInputs; the file drawer gained chips and an action menu. The agent tabs reuse the same tables, so they grow with them. Splitting the upload dialog into a lazy chunk saved under 3 kB on files.tsx and the chunk itself measured 61187, over the route budget, so the dialog stays in the route. The book and wizard routes grew by about 0.5 kB and 0.8 kB with the shared control height and the PeekCard status wash. The entry stayed within 217000 (measured 213572).
